attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Massachusetts state income tax calculation. Implements flat 5.0% rate with 4% surtax on high incomes per MA tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Massachusetts Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MA tax for Single filers
action_details.action_postfix:
# Calculate base taxable income (AGI - personal exemption, minimum $8,000 threshold) result.agi get result.ma_exemption_single get sub 0 max result.ma_income_threshold get max
# Calculate base tax at 5% result.ma_tax_rate get mul
# Calculate surtax if applicable (4% on income over $1,083,150) result.agi get result.ma_surtax_threshold get sub 0 max result.ma_surtax_rate get mul
# Total tax = base tax + surtax add
/result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Massachusetts tax calculated for Single: $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Massachusetts military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per MA Gen. Laws ch. 62, § 2 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Massachusetts Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.ma_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.ma_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.ma_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.ma_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.ma_military_retirement_exclusion result.ma_sbp_exclusion add /result.ma_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.ma_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.ma_adjusted_agi xdef
"Massachusetts military retirement exclusion: $" result.ma_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ma_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Massachusetts SBP exclusion: $" result.ma_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Massachusetts total military exclusion: $" result.ma_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
